qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Single-payer government price-taker. US Medicare ESRD Prospective Payment System dictates fixed reimbursement rates, completely stripping pricing power. Multi-year ROIC of 2.8-5.0% fails the 12% hurdle by a wide margin.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3a/3b (No Moat / Zero Pricing Power, REJECT). Dialysis clinic operations are captive to government reimbursement price caps (Medicare ESRD PPS), eliminating pricing power while nurse wage inflation compresses margins. Multi-year ROIC of 2.8-5.0% fails the 12% hurdle by a wide margin.
qualitative.evidence: Reported ROIC of 2.8% (2023), 3.5% (2024), and 5.0% (2025). Severe margin compression from US clinical labor shortages and fixed statutory Medicare reimbursement schedules. Long-term treatment volumes pressured by GLP-1 kidney disease progression delay.
